correctness.rationale: Explicit central-spin enumeration gives the displayed polynomial. An exact disk-Blaschke quotient proves the circle property; its positive boundary derivative proves simplicity. For |z|=1/2 the reflection quotient is ≤τ^m/2, so Cauchy gives the all-k finite power-sum bound with its stated k2^k factor. Fourier uniqueness and Hausdorff compact moment determinacy prove the weak density limit and the inverse. A uniform cubic phase remainder and derivative lower bound yield root spacing. Exact rational and numerical checks of the stated proof steps were run successfully in verify.py; they are checks rather than substitutes for infinite proofs.

Here a natural high-degree heterogeneous star limit has a complete explicit density, and the zero spectrum encodes all moments of an unknown bond distribution with exponentially precise finite-size moment comparison; the leading zero spacing also records its local density.
